ThingDef.label: candy cooker table
ThingDef.description: An electrically-powered confectionary equipment to make all kinds of candies and sweets.

ThingDef.label: chemfuel grill
ThingDef.description: A grill is a device that cooks food by applying heat from below. This is a chemfuel powered grill that needs chemfuel as fuel to work.

ThingDef.label: rustic churn
ThingDef.description: A manual device used to agitate milk into other products.

ThingDef.label: coffee machine
ThingDef.description: An automatic coffee machine brews coffee by forcing pressurized water near boiling point through a "puck" of ground coffee and a filter in order to produce a thick, concentrated coffee. This particular machine also has the possibility of brewing tea using a separate system.

ThingDef.label: electric churn
ThingDef.description: A powered device used to agitate milk into other products.

ThingDef.label: electric mill
ThingDef.description: A small semi-industrial device that mills grains into flour. Dry grains are poured into the funnel, milled by blades like a blender, and then gathered in bags from an outlet.

ThingDef.label: electric oven
ThingDef.description: A electric oven used for baking.

ThingDef.label: grill
ThingDef.description: A grill is a device that cooks food by applying heat from below. The grill needs wood as fuel to work.

ThingDef.label: hand quern
ThingDef.description: A primitive hand mill for grinding grain.

ThingDef.label: wood-fired oven
ThingDef.description: A stone oven used for baking.

ThingDef.label: mead barrel
ThingDef.description: A rustic sealed keg used to brew mead.

ThingDef.label: rum barrel
ThingDef.description: A rustic sealed keg used to brew rum.

ThingDef.label: soda barrel
ThingDef.description: A tapped barrel used for carbonating soda.

ThingDef.label: wine fermenting barrel
ThingDef.description: A barrel for fermenting grape must into wine. Its wooden properties help with producing rustic elements to the taste.

ThingDef.label: beehive
ThingDef.description: A wooden enclosure to host bees. No need to plant flowers near the hive, but it is quite sensible to temperature.

ThingDef.label: cheese press
ThingDef.description: A cheese press is a device for pressing whey from curds when making cheese. Pressing influences the cheese's hardness and texture and will also determine the shape of the block or wheel of cheese.

ThingDef.label: meat rack
ThingDef.description: A wooden rack where meat are hung and salted until their humidity levels are extremely low, once this process is finished, the salted meat is ready to be used in cooking or stored for long periods of time.

ThingDef.label: oil presser
ThingDef.description: A wooden contraption to press selected items. Either to bring the juice out or whey from curds.

ThingDef.label: sausage post
ThingDef.description: A wooden post used to hang sausages and let them age. Sausages need to stay at a relatively cool temperature in order to properly dry and achieve their undistinguishable flavour.
